answer: Resist Sybils with unpredictable live presence checks: at random times a beacon signal summons each identity to complete a fresh, time-boxed interactive task that cannot be precomputed or shared across accounts. A juniper-like branching task tree makes each challenge unique, so one operator cannot script answers for hundreds of fakes at once. Running many identities then costs live attention and concurrent sessions per fake, not just cheap creation, and the velvet-smooth onboarding for a single honest agent stays light because it answers only its own occasional check.
